lessonTitleEnglish: Volumes of a cylinder and a cone — Practice

stages.headlineEnglish: A cylinder has volume 90π. Volume of the cone with the same base and height?

stages.headline: Գլանի շառավիղը կրկնապատկվեց։ Քանի՞ անգամ մեծացավ ծավալը։
stages.headlineEnglish: A cylinder's radius doubles. How many times larger is the volume?
stages.problemText: A cylinder's radius doubles. How many times larger is the volume?
